# UI Requirements Quality Checklist: M4 Desktop UI

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements text covering §6 UI, R6 sync triggers, the R22
pre-restore copy, the holiday range decision, and the §9 smoke test only.
**Created**: 2026-10-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) (with [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md),
[contracts/](../contracts/))

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: standard. Audience: reviewer before implementation. Scope limited to the five areas in the
request; core rules R1–R25 are only checked where the UI surfaces them.

## §6 UI — Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are the five pages and the contents of each page listed with no §6 item missing (Dashboard sections R16–R20 + banner, Timetable week + Rules tab, Courses list + detail + makeup form, Assessments filters + checkbox, Settings items)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, FR-011–FR-027]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is an empty-state requirement stated for every list, including the Rules tab slot list, the holiday list, the course detail session list, and each dashboard section? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, US3-5]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the actions available on a selected week-view session enumerated, including reset to Pending, and is it stated which actions are disabled before the session starts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, R12]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are the fields of every form (term, course, slot add/edit/end, reschedule, makeup, assessment, holiday, settings) listed with which are required and which are optional? [Completeness, Spec §US1–US6, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is the content of each row type specified (week row: time, course code and name, room, status label; assessment row; course row; slot row)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014, contracts/viewmodel.md]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is the startup failure screen (DB cannot be opened, R25 newer schema) described in enough detail to know what the window shows instead of the pages? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]

## §6 UI — Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 - Is the boundary between static copy allowed in `.slint` files and data-derived text that must come from the view model defined unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, research R-D8]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are the exact inline error messages for malformed `YYYY-MM-DD` and `HH:MM` input specified, and is "strict format" defined (e.g. is `2026-1-5` rejected)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, research R-D9]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "percentage rounded to one decimal" expressed with concrete display examples (`50.0%`, `66.7%`, `—`), consistent between course detail and banner? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, FR-018, R13]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is it clear where core validation (R2) errors appear versus field format errors (field-level vs form-level)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, research R-D11]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the "reference date" for the Rules tab slot list defined, and is it stated what happens to slots that ended before it? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, FR-016]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "forms are inline panels or dialogs" resolved to one choice per form, so the confirm-restore interaction is unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, research R-D12]

## §6 UI — Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK013 - Do the status labels and chip pairings agree across spec FR-003, DESIGN.md, and the view-model contract, including "Rescheduled → {date}" shown with the Cancelled chip? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, contracts/viewmodel.md]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the requirement that reschedule of an attended/absent session shows the core error (US4-4) consistent with any UI enablement rule (no reschedule button hidden or disabled by the UI)? [Consistency, Spec §US4-4, R9]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are the theme requirements (every token in `theme.slint`, grep check in CI) consistent with the §12.3 grep command and with DESIGN.md tokens that have no Slint equivalent (line height, font fallback)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, FR-002, research R-D13]
- [ ] CHK016 - Do the archived-course visibility requirements agree between Courses (show-archived toggle), Timetable, Dashboard, and course detail history? [Consistency, Spec §US1-7, R3]

## R6 Sync Triggers

- [ ] CHK017 - Is the complete list of sync triggers stated (start, term save, holiday add/remove, course create/update/archive/unarchive, slot add/change/end, restore, date rollover)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, FR-010]
- [ ] CHK018 - Is it explicit which mutations do NOT trigger a sync (status change, reschedule, makeup, assessments, settings), so implementers do not over- or under-sync? [Clarity, Gap, research R-D14]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is "date has changed since the last sync" defined precisely (compared to the date of the last sync, including a clock moved backwards)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, contracts/viewmodel.md `date_rolled_over`]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is "refresh the visible page" reconciled with the plan's choice to refresh all pages, and is refresh on page switch and on each tick stated? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the behavior specified when a sync itself fails (where the error appears, whether the mutation that preceded it stands)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the "within about a minute" rollover expectation measurable for the human check? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases]

## R22 Pre-restore Copy

- [ ] CHK023 - Is the ordering of the restore flow fully specified (file pick → confirm → copy → restore → sync → refresh), including that restore is not attempted when the copy fails? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, US6-7]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is `{data_dir}` defined for both the default R24 path and the `ACADEMIC_PLANNER_DB` override? [Clarity, Gap, research R-D4]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is "copy containing all committed data" stated as a verifiable property (WAL-committed transactions included)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-025]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is the same-minute file name clash rule (suffix `-2`, `-3`, …, human decision Q2) recorded where both implementer and tester will see it? [Completeness, research R-D4, contracts/viewmodel.md]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are cancel paths (file dialog cancelled, confirm cancelled) specified to copy nothing and change nothing? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 - Is the confirm-dialog warning text requirement specific enough ("all current data will be replaced")? [Clarity, Spec §US6-7]
- [ ] CHK029 - Is it recorded that the pre-restore copy has no file-database test (Principle II, Q1 = B) and is verified manually instead? [Traceability, plan.md Constitution Check, quickstart.md §6]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is the user-visible outcome after a successful restore defined (message naming the copy path, every page showing restored data)? [Completeness, Spec §US6-7, SC-007]

## Holiday Range Decision

- [ ] CHK031 - Is "inclusive" range expansion specified with an example and a stated count (e.g. five-day exam period = five holidays)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, SC-006]
- [ ] CHK032 - Is the error for end-before-start and for malformed dates specified, including that no holiday is added? [Completeness, Spec §US6-3]
- [ ] CHK033 - Is the overlap rule defined (each date ends as exactly one holiday carrying the range's label, replacing an existing label)? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 - Is per-day removal of a date that came from a range specified (only that date removed, sync again)? [Completeness, Spec §US6-4]
- [ ] CHK035 - Is the behavior for range dates outside the term stated (stored as given, no session effect)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, R4]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is adding a holiday with no active term covered? [Edge Case, Gap, contracts/ui-bridge.md]
- [ ] CHK037 - Is the label optional, and is how an empty label is shown in the list specified? [Clarity, contracts/viewmodel.md `holiday_row`]

## §9 Smoke Test

- [ ] CHK038 - Does every §9 smoke step map to at least one functional requirement in spec.md (term, courses, slots, week view, mark attendance, 50.0%, cancel, reschedule, assessment, dashboard, backup, restore, CSV export)? [Traceability, Spec §FR-030, SC-001]
- [ ] CHK039 - Is the §9 step "delete a course's data" achievable with the specified UI (there is no course delete in §6; archive or assessment delete only)? [Ambiguity, Spec §9, FR-017]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are the smoke step preconditions stated so "mark one past session" is possible on the smoke day (past sessions exist this week, e.g. slot valid-from defaulting to term start)? [Assumption, research R-D16]
- [ ] CHK041 - Is SC-001's "about 5 minutes without errors or crashes" an acceptable pass/fail criterion for the human, and is who records the result stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK042 - Are the screenshot critique scope (one per page + one empty state) and the "no open high-severity items" exit rule defined consistently with §12.3? [Consistency, Spec §FR-029, SC-005]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK039 flags a likely ambiguity in §9 itself; resolving it is a human call, not an agent edit
